# Apache Rat exclusions for the nbfx source release (`ant rat`).
# One Ant-style pattern per line, relative to the repository root.
# Mirrors the generic entries of netbeans/nbbuild/rat-exclusions.txt.

# licence, notice and key files
LICENSE
NOTICE
THIRDPARTY
KEYS
**/release/legal/**

# git metadata
.gitmodules

# module manifests and service registrations (upstream excludes them too)
**/*.mf
**/src/META-INF/**

# upstream patches: they modify Apache NetBeans files and carry no header of their own
patches/*.patch

# version marker read by the build
**/javafx.version

# generated by docs/plan/tools/Counts.java
docs/plan/figures.md

# empty directory placeholders
**/.gitkeep
